run_pybullet_gui_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads the Aliengo quadruped robot URDF model onto a plane
load_urdf_robot_model: load the Aliengo URDF robot model at position [0,0,0.5] using pybullet loadURDF
discover_motor_joint_ids: discover motor joint IDs by iterating over robot joints and matching against MOTOR_NAMES list
set_joint_position_control: set position control on each motor joint using setJointMotorControl2 with INIT_MOTOR_ANGLES
reset_joint_states: reset each motor joint state to its initial angle using resetJointState with INIT_MOTOR_ANGLES
